exactDdl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication(publication_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL,plan_reference BLOB NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,source_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,old_evolution_version INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_items INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_items BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),staged_items INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PREPARING','PUBLISHED')),prepared_at INTEGER NOT NULL,published_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item(publication_id TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0),kind TEXT NOT NULL,item_key TEXT NOT NULL,item_hash TEXT NOT NULL,c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5,c6,c7,c8,c9,c10,c11,c12,c13,c14,c15,PRIMARY KEY(publication_id,ordinal),UNIQUE(publication_id,kind,item_key)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_kind ON r31_model_publication_item(publication_id,kind,ordinal)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part(content_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_hash)=64),part INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(part>=0),part_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(part_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count BETWEEN 1 AND 33554432),bytes BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 16384),PRIMARY KEY(content_hash,part)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_clock(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),evolution_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_quota(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(logical_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 268435456),part_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(part_rows BETWEEN 0 AND 32768),item_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(item_rows BETWEEN 0 AND 65536),root_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(root_rows BETWEEN 0 AND 1024))

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication_item WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_item WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id AND ordinal=NEW.ordinal) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_item WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id AND ordinal=NEW.ordinal AND kind IS NEW.kind AND item_key IS NEW.item_key AND item_hash IS NEW.item_hash AND c0 IS NEW.c0 AND c1 IS NEW.c1 AND c2 IS NEW.c2 AND c3 IS NEW.c3 AND c4 IS NEW.c4 AND c5 IS NEW.c5 AND c6 IS NEW.c6 AND c7 IS NEW.c7 AND c8 IS NEW.c8 AND c9 IS NEW.c9 AND c10 IS NEW.c10 AND c11 IS NEW.c11 AND c12 IS NEW.c12 AND c13 IS NEW.c13 AND c14 IS NEW.c14 AND c15 IS NEW.c15) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_model_publication_item BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_model_publication_item BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication_part WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_part WHERE content_hash=NEW.content_hash AND part=NEW.part) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_part WHERE content_hash=NEW.content_hash AND part=NEW.part AND part_count IS NEW.part_count AND byte_count IS NEW.byte_count AND bytes IS NEW.bytes) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_model_publication_part BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_model_publication_part BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_STAGING_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id AND manifest_hash IS NEW.manifest_hash AND plan_reference IS NEW.plan_reference AND kind IS NEW.kind AND source_hash IS NEW.source_hash AND source_generation IS NEW.source_generation AND old_evolution_version IS NEW.old_evolution_version AND expected_items IS NEW.expected_items AND prepared_at IS NEW.prepared_at) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_model_publication BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_header BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_model_publication WHEN NEW.publication_id IS NOT OLD.publication_id OR NEW.manifest_hash IS NOT OLD.manifest_hash OR NEW.plan_reference IS NOT OLD.plan_reference OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.source_hash IS NOT OLD.source_hash OR NEW.source_generation IS NOT OLD.source_generation OR NEW.old_evolution_version IS NOT OLD.old_evolution_version OR NEW.expected_items IS NOT OLD.expected_items OR NEW.prepared_at IS NOT OLD.prepared_at OR NEW.staged_items<OLD.staged_items OR OLD.status='PUBLISHED' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_HEADER_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_evolution_insert AFTER INSERT ON su2_evolution_state BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_clock SET evolution_version=evolution_version+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_evolution_update AFTER UPDATE ON su2_evolution_state BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_clock SET evolution_version=evolution_version+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_evolution_delete AFTER DELETE ON su2_evolution_state BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_clock SET evolution_version=evolution_version+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication_part WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_part WHERE content_hash=NEW.content_hash AND part=NEW.part) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+(192+length(NEW.bytes))<=268435456 AND part_rows<32768) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_PROTECTED_STORAGE_DEBT') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_part_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_model_publication_part BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+(192+length(NEW.bytes)),part_rows=part_rows+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication_item WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_item WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id AND ordinal=NEW.ordinal) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.item_key AS BLOB))+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c0 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c1 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c2 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c3 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c4 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c5 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c6 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c7 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c8 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c9 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c10 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c11 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c12 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c13 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c14 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c15 AS BLOB)),0))<=268435456 AND item_rows<65536) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_PROTECTED_STORAGE_DEBT') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_item_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_model_publication_item BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.item_key AS BLOB))+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c0 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c1 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c2 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c3 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c4 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c5 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c6 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c7 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c8 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c9 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c10 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c11 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c12 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c13 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c14 AS BLOB)),0)+coalesce(length(CAST(NEW.c15 AS BLOB)),0)),item_rows=item_rows+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_model_publication WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication WHERE publication_id=NEW.publication_id) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_model_publication_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.publication_id AS BLOB))+length(CAST(NEW.source_hash AS BLOB)))<=268435456 AND root_rows<1024) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_MODEL_PUBLICATION_PROTECTED_STORAGE_DEBT') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_model_publication_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_model_publication BEGIN UPDATE r31_model_publication_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.publication_id AS BLOB))+length(CAST(NEW.source_hash AS BLOB))),root_rows=root_rows+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
